status: Normative specification and offline scalar-component validator; not wired into frozen discovery code

scope.mathematical: Finite compositions of registered real elementary functions, arithmetic, and all finite multi-index spatial derivatives of declared fields and expressions
scope.equation_form: Each output component u_r,t = F_r(x,t,j^m u;theta)
scope.spatial_dimension: Any fixed positive integer d at the representation level
scope.field_count: Any fixed positive integer q at the representation level
scope.coordinates: Cartesian by default; other coordinate charts require explicit metric/coefficient definitions
scope.coverage_claim: Relative expressivity within the registered language, not completeness for all smooth functions or all PDEs

execution_profile.existing_numerical_backends: Historical 1D and scalar 2D adapters only; new functions and general d/q still need numerical integration
execution_profile.depth_node_and_fit_budgets: Separate search settings; not mathematical definitions or literature-guaranteed constants

CubeRoot.real_domain: R, real root; derivatives singular at 0

Sinc.real_domain: R; sin(z)/z with value 1 at z=0, NOT NumPy normalized sinc

derived_macros.Vorticity2D: D_1 V_2-D_2 V_1; scalar out-of-plane component
derived_macros.TensorContraction: Explicit finite component sums with declared shapes and contraction axes

derivative_order: max order of children for arithmetic/functions; |alpha| + child order for PD. Thus (u_xx)^2 has PDE order 2, not 4

graph_contract.node: Registered expression with typed component form, declared symbols, parameters, order, domain and canonical syntax key
graph_contract.edge: Each nonconstant dependency is recorded with construction_id, operation, operand position and birth round; alternative derivations reuse the node and retain separate construction records
graph_contract.canonicalization: Aliases and exact syntactic duplicates; continuous identities are separate annotations and do not silently merge different numerical evaluation paths
graph_contract.cost: Expression-based complexity; macro expansion does not make a compound mechanism cost one node

domain_policy: Real-valued domains and required differentiability must be checked separately in numerical execution. The offline validator certifies syntax/order only; it never replaces Log(E) with Log(abs(E)+epsilon)
not_in_v1: Nonsmooth Piecewise/Abs without a separate execution profile
Implicit or higher-time-order discovery without a new residual adapter
